solution.approach: We introduce H3DNet, which takes a colorless 3D point cloud as input and outputs a collection of oriented object bounding boxes (or BB) and their semantic labels.

evidence.quote: We introduce H3DNet, which takes a colorless 3D point cloud as input and outputs a collection of oriented object bounding boxes (or BB) and their semantic labels.
In this paper, we show that predicting BB centers, BB face centers, and BB edge centers together help to improve the generalization behavior of primitive predictions.

experiments.summary: Our model achieves state-of-the-art 3D detection results on two large datasets with real 3D scans, ScanNet and SUN RGB-D. Choosing suitable intermediate representations to integrate low-level object cues into detected objects is key to the performance of the resulting system.
